QuestInfo.name: Driving Out the Demons
QuestInfo.0: #p1404005# disappeared. Now that he's a soul, can you actually catch him? Time to do some thinking!
QuestInfo.1: You were told that a roaming soul's body must be somewhere. Even #p1404005# said that his real form was somewhere in this time. \n\nThe only place an unconscious Black Wing leader would be safe is #m310000000#! Board the #b#m150000000##k and tell #b#p1401001##k to find #p1404005#'s body.
QuestInfo.2: If you find #p1404005#'s body, you might be able to stop him. It's certainly not safe to just let him wander around as an evil ghost.

0.0: Where did he go?! How am I supposed to catch a ghost? Man, first I find out #p1404005#'s alive and now he can possess people? I wonder if Orchid knows about this.
0.1: I really wanted to find out why he's been destroying historical records. Could... could he have caused the war 300 years ago?
0.2: I shouldn't jump to conclusions. No matter how small his plans may be, he has to be stopped. He was dangerous enough when he was just a man. Now...
0.3: How do I find him? How do you find an inert body that hasn't been seen for hundreds of years? You find their family! #bHe and Orchid were inseparable#k, they won't likely be apart now!

yes.1: And where do you keep the body of a twin sibling you can't stand to be apart from? Right next to you, of course! It must be at #m310000000#!
yes.2: I'd be walking into a hornet's nest if I went now. A quick trip back to the #b#m150000000##k to get #b#p1401001##k's take on all this and then I'll find that ghost-man!
yes.0: If the soul roams while the body lies still, #b#p1404005#'s body must be kept somewhere safe#k. And if I can't stop a ghost, I can sure as heck go beat up a sleeping guy!

1.0: Hey boss, why are you in such a hurry?\r\n#L0##b(You tell her all about your run in with the ghost of #p1404005#, the commander of the Black Wings.)#l\n#k
1.1: That sounds nutso! Who woulda thought they'd have a new commander AND a ghost to boot. I'm going to have to do some real dirty work to get all the info we need for this job. \r\n#L0##bFind whatever you can on #m310000000#. #p1404005# and Orchid are twins, like two sides of the same coin. They won't be far apart. Find Orchid, and you find #p1404005#.#l\n#k
1.2: That's good thinking, boss. I'll find Orchid, even if I don't know a thing about her. \r\n#L0##bThe Black Wings have been mining #m310000000# for energy, right? Maybe this is related to #p1404005#. #l\n#k
1.3: I'll cross-reference #rCommander Orchid's possible locations with the Black Wings' mining efforts#k.

yes.0: Keep calm and train. I'll let you know when I find them.
